draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling has a lower median latency than Talmar (41 vs 118 ms per utterance), though the two latencies were measured on different accelerators (Corvex A2 fp16 vs Corvex A1 fp32).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 and T1.r2.lat=118 directly support a latency difference. The hedge "may" understates the reported values. However, the comparison is cross-hardware (A2 fp16 vs A1 fp32) and Talmar was not re-timed, so an unhedged claim should note this scope.
